title: Create unit test runner and parameter state tests
description:
Create tests/TestMain.cpp as a juce::UnitTestRunner console entry point (int main that runs all registered juce::UnitTest instances and returns non-zero on any failure) and tests/ParameterTests.cpp implementing a juce::UnitTest that validates the parameter taxonomy and state round-trip. Tests must: (1) confirm createParameterLayout() produces exactly the 11 expected parameters with correct IDs, ranges, and defaults; (2) confirm voicing_mode default is Yng-Grey, oversampling default is 2x, auto_gain default is Off; (3) round-trip APVTS state via getStateInformation/setStateInformation and assert restored values are identical to the pre-save values, and assert the embedded schema version equals 1. Register a CTest target in CMakeLists.txt: add the unit-test executable linking JUCE + the Source parameter files, and register it with add_test so it runs under ctest. Do not use any third-party testing framework — juce::UnitTest only.

Before editing, inspect:
- Source/Parameters/ParameterIDs.h, ParameterLayout.h, ParameterSnapshot.h (APIs under test)
- Source/PluginProcessor.h/.cpp (getStateInformation/setStateInformation)
- CMakeLists.txt (existing targets, JUCE target linkage, where to add the test executable and add_test)

STRICT FILE SCOPE: Create or modify ONLY the files listed in this task's allowed_write_paths.
acceptance_criteria: tests/TestMain.cpp exists and runs all registered juce::UnitTest instances via a console runner, returning non-zero on failure

tests/ParameterTests.cpp implements a juce::UnitTest asserting the 11 parameters, their defaults (voicing_mode=Yng-Grey, oversampling=2x, auto_gain=Off), and that a getStateInformation/setStateInformation round-trip restores identical parameter values with embedded schema version equal to 1
CMakeLists.txt registers a unit-test executable via add_test so it is discoverable by ctest, using only juce::UnitTest (no third-party test framework)
cmake --preset linux configure succeeds and ctest runs the parameter test target
No file outside the task's allowed_write_paths is created or modified
forbidden_changes: add third-party testing frameworks (Catch2, GoogleTest, doctest, etc.)
